protocol.latest_user_authorization: Use all24GPUs productively for high-performing sample-level algorithm research; retain short gates and stop unneeded runs.
protocol.concurrency: 20short adaptation trials plus4bounded stage2 continuations occupy all24 authorized GPU slots.
protocol.screening_scope: Adaptation from an existing mature2epochmodel, not training from scratch. Every method has a matched original continuation from exactly the same weights, optimizer/scheduler/RNG/cursor. No candidate may continue beyond600updates until numerical/gradient/state-use and task evidence are reviewed.

original.hypothesis: Same posterior/flow/rate objective; establishes continuation and runtime noise.

clean-prior.hypothesis: Read posterior means in the dynamics prior while keeping rendering noise; remove the input-noise Jacobian penalty. This changes the code-length objective.

innovation-corrected.hypothesis: Subtract known carried posterior perturbation from the predicted state before pricing innovations; preserve learning of physical residuals. Not the original Markov KL.

antithetic-rate.hypothesis: Average squared errors for plus/minus posterior-noise draws; same expected rate under symmetric Gaussian noise, potentially lower gradient variance; extra prior compute.

marginal-prior.hypothesis: Average plus/minus noisy prior means before pricing prediction error; removes local linear noise variation. Jensen changes the objective; not an unbiased original KL.

overshoot.hypothesis: Mix one-step rate with deterministic multi-step predictions from3observations; match planning horizon. Both targets remain attached; no EMA/stop-gradient. Inspired by latent overshooting, not claimed invented.

window-free-bits.hypothesis: Apply a0.5nat per-window/per-dimension floor to variable rate, retaining entry constants. No batch-expected freebits; not identical to literature objective.

motion-weighted.hypothesis: Weight FM residuals by within-window target-frame changes, normalized only inside each sample. Emphasize small moving objects; no state labels or inference-time future frames.

shared-flow-noise.hypothesis: Share renderer noise/time within a video window; same per-frame marginal flow objective with a different gradient estimator.

differential-flow.hypothesis: Add adjacent-time residual differences under shared renderer noise/time. Common noise cancels in differences, directing gradients to predicted motion; compare shared-noise control.

sources.name: PlaNet latent overshooting
sources.relationship: Prior multi-step latent training principle; our deterministic attached-target mix is an adaptation, not the same variational bound.

sources.name: Differentiable Antithetic Sampling
sources.relationship: Known variance-reduction principle; not our invention.

sources.name: Improving Variational Inference with IAF
sources.relationship: Prior free-bits context; our per-sample floor explicitly differs from a batch-expected KL floor.

sources.name: Noise regularization analysis
sources.relationship: Input noise induces derivative regularization; motivates exact linear-Gaussian diagnostic, not a new theorem.

loss_constraints: Each objective is an average of per-video-window terms.
No cross-sample statistics, SIGReg, contrastive negatives from other samples, BatchNorm, EMA or target network.
Exact same trainable tensors/parameter count and inference architecture.
Frame motion weights use same-sample training targets only; rollout never receives futureRGB.
Additional compute is reported; same update count is not an equal-compute claim.
Surrogates must not be called exact KL or a proven likelihood bound.

first_gate.training: 600updates,finite weights/loss and gradients; checkpoint saved and stopped.
first_gate.posterior_health: 32cases,Euler20,own noisy state vs anchor plus zero/permuted interventions; interpret alongside matched original.
first_gate.reference: Original continued600updates is primary; saved originalepoch2checkpoint is a no-update reference.
first_gate.bad_methods: Stop on numerical/gradient contract failure; defer a method clearly worsening paired task metrics without compensating signal.
first_gate.ambiguous: Only one limited next stage for at most3promisingmechanismfamilies, based on paired evidence and cost; no automatic full3epochgrid.

protocol.reserved_confirmation: Methods/diagnostic seeds are selected; final winner needs reserved unseen training seeds and fresh eval cases.
protocol.publication: Commit/push useful positive, negative and inconclusive results with complete numerical outcomes and key scientific figures.

limitations: 600update adaptation from an existing2epochcheckpoint; not from-scratch training or a stability result.
Seeds1/2 are selected diagnostic seeds; final claims need reserved independent training seeds.
P0twoevalseeds,16CFcases and64generationclips are a screen, not the full original benchmark.
Bootstrap intervals condition on these fixed weights and episode clusters; not uncertainty across training seeds.
Ninecandidate/control comparisons are exploratory with no multiple-testing correction; selected wins require independent confirmation.
Some rate objectives are surrogates; their audit one-step rate is a reference and not the actual optimized quantity.
Same parameter/update count is not equal compute; report per-arm training time and extra model calls.
Future states only enter training targets within the same video; no futureRGB is passed to inference.
